text: The Patriots head into Thursday night's Week 7 matchup against the Bears significantly short-handed along the offensive line, with starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown both ruled out due to injuries and placed on injured reserve, forcing the team to elevate offensive lineman Xavier Newman-Johnson from the practice squad to bolster depth. On the bright side, starting right tackle Morgan Moses, who was listed as questionable, is officially active for the primetime showdown, and linebacker Benton Whitley has also been elevated to the active roster. The game itself features an intriguing quarterback storyline, as Drake Maye and Chicago's Caleb Williams—who were part of the same draft class and grew up attending the same football camps—square off in what promises to be a compelling clash of recent first-round talent. Meanwhile, running back Rhamondre Stevenson continues his workhorse role for New England and sits on the cusp of reaching 100 carries for the sixth consecutive season, providing some continuity in an otherwise depleted offensive unit.
